videos.caption: Keeping your toes healthy is important for overall foot care. Wash your feet daily with mild soap and dry them well, especially between the toes, to prevent moisture buildup. Trim your nails straight across to avoid ingrown toenails. Wear comfortable, breathable shoes that fit properly to prevent pressure and irritation. Moisturize your feet but avoid applying lotion between the toes to reduce the risk of fungal infections. Check your toes regularly for any changes, discomfort, or signs of infection, and consult a professional if needed. #toe #relaxing #oddlysatisfying #satisfyingvideo  #healthytoe

👣 Por que os pés racham? Descubra os 7 vilões do pé seco: 🧼 1. Ressecamento natural A sola dos pés tem poucas glândulas sebáceas. Sem hidratação frequente, a pele resseca e racha. 👠 2. Calçados abertos demais Chinelos e rasteiras deixam o calcanhar exposto ao sol, poeira e atrito — e isso só piora a rachadura. 🧽 3. Banhos quentes e demorados A água quente remove a camada protetora da pele. Resultado: pés ainda mais secos. 💅 4. Falta de hidratação e esfoliação Você cuida do rosto... mas e dos pés? Sem hidratação, a pele endurece e racha com o tempo. ⚖️ 5. Pressão do peso corporal Quem está acima do peso ou passa muito tempo em pé tem mais fissuras no calcanhar. 👩‍🦰 6. Alterações hormonais Gravidez, menopausa e ciclo menstrual afetam a hidratação natural da pele. 🦶 7. Andar descalça O contato direto com o chão engrossa a pele e favorece rachaduras. ✨ Você também sofre com isso? What gets checked before we pour concrete? On this ADU project, we’re preparing the attached garage footing for inspection. - Footing size and depth help provide the support shown in the structural plans. - Rebar reinforces the concrete, and proper placement keeps it surrounded by enough concrete to protect it. - Epoxied rebar connections tie the new footing into the existing foundation. Where required, a deputy inspector checks the installation before it gets covered. - Anchor bolts secure the garage’s wood framing to the concrete foundation. Their location, spacing, and embedment matter. For homeowners, this is why inspections before the pour are so important. These connections become hidden once the concrete is placed, so this is the time to verify that the work follows the approved plans.
